title: Edging
body: A visible clean line where turf meets hard surfaces (drives, walks, curbs). A trimmer in the photo is not proof of edging.
source: Example only — replace with your operations handbook

title: Wet grass after rain
body: Clumped clippings on a freshly mown lawn are normal after rain. They are not a sign that mowing was incomplete.

title: Demo Client A: drive edges
body: Demo Client A expects the driveway edge in at least one after photo. If it is missing, escalate rather than reject.
